name: What kind of paint finish is best for selling a house?

mainEntity.name: What kind of paint finish is best for selling a house?

acceptedAnswer.text: For selling a house, a matte or eggshell finish is generally recommended for interior walls. These finishes are excellent at hiding minor imperfections and provide a soft, non-reflective appearance that enhances natural light. For trim and doors, a semi-gloss or satin finish is ideal as it's more durable and easier to clean, offering a subtle contrast. Avoid high-gloss finishes on walls as they highlight every flaw. Opt for low-VOC (volatile organic compound) paints to minimize odors for showings.
acceptedAnswer.description: Use matte or eggshell finishes for interior walls to hide imperfections and semi-gloss or satin for trim for durability. Choose low-VOC paints.
